critique.evidence: The oversized “Accuracy is the wrong question.” thesis, cyan/red signal palette, monospaced evaluation-ledger labels, and operating-constraint framing give the screen a recognizable editorial identity across desktop, tablet, and mobile. However, the main body remains a familiar sequence of KPI tiles, standard charts, confusion matrix, and ablation table; there is no singular visual mechanism that makes this metrics view unmistakably AI Defense Lab or especially demo-worthy.
critique.fix: Build the thesis into one signature visualization—for example, an interactive operating-point map that contrasts impressive accuracy with recall, false-positive cost, fraud value caught, and latency as the threshold moves. Make that transformation the hero artifact, then subordinate the conventional cards and tables to it.
